records.context: Candidate names come from ``_identity_words``; names shorter than three characters, all-digit names and entries in ``_GENERIC_NAMES`` are omitted. Matches are case-insensitive and blocked if either adjacent character matches ``[A-Za-z0-9]`` under ``re.IGNORECASE``; underscores do not block them. Home-string substitution is handled separately by :func:`sanitize_path`.

records.source: Candidate names come from ``_identity_words``; names shorter than three characters, all-digit names and entries in ``_GENERIC_NAMES`` are omitted. Matches are case-insensitive and blocked if either adjacent character matches ``[A-Za-z0-9]`` under ``re.IGNORECASE``; underscores do not block them. Home-string substitution is handled separately by :func:`sanitize_path`.
records.translation: 候选名称来自 ``_identity_words``；长度不足三个字符的名称、完全由数字组成的名称以及 ``_GENERIC_NAMES`` 中的条目会被排除。匹配不区分大小写；如果任一相邻字符匹配 ``[A-Za-z0-9]``（使用 ``re.IGNORECASE``），则该匹配会被阻止；下划线不会阻止匹配。主目录字符串的替换由 :func:`sanitize_path` 单独处理。

records.translation: 执行主目录字符串的字面替换和基于模式的脱敏。

records.context: Replace exact, case-sensitive occurrences of ``str(Path.home())`` with ``~`` wherever they occur; no path boundaries are checked. Replace substrings matching the case-sensitive database-path regex with ``<DB>``: a slash or backslash, one or more characters other than whitespace or single/double quotes, then ``.db`` and a regex word boundary. Finally apply :func:`redact_identity` and :func:`redact_secrets`. These substitutions do not guarantee removal of every identifier or credential.
records.label: spacr.qt.ai.issue_report.sanitize_path#1
records.source: Replace exact, case-sensitive occurrences of ``str(Path.home())`` with ``~`` wherever they occur; no path boundaries are checked. Replace substrings matching the case-sensitive database-path regex with ``<DB>``: a slash or backslash, one or more characters other than whitespace or single/double quotes, then ``.db`` and a regex word boundary. Finally apply :func:`redact_identity` and :func:`redact_secrets`. These substitutions do not guarantee removal of every identifier or credential.
records.translation: 无论出现在哪里，都按区分大小写的方式将 ``str(Path.home())`` 返回值的精确匹配替换为 ``~``；不检查路径边界。将匹配区分大小写的数据库路径正则表达式的子字符串替换为 ``<DB>``：一个斜杠或反斜杠，后接一个或多个既非空白也非单引号或双引号的字符，再接 ``.db`` 和正则表达式词边界。最后应用 :func:`redact_identity` 和 :func:`redact_secrets`。这些替换不能保证移除所有标识符或凭据。
